summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K to disclose a notification from BlackRock, Inc. that its aggregate holding (voting rights attached to shares plus financial instruments) crossed above 5%, reaching 4.92% direct voting rights plus 1.30% through financial instruments for a total 6.22%. This is a routine regulatory threshold disclosure under AIM Rules, not a special situation transaction. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are involved. The notification is a passive ownership update with no strategic implications; there is nothing to watch from a special-situations perspective.
